The suspects according to a report by NTA include Ibrahim Jiji, Aminu Haliru, Mohammed Ali, Usman Aliyu and Babangida Aliyu.
They were arrested during intelligence-led operations carried out between October 10 and 14 in Rivers and Abia states.
LEADERSHIP recalls that the 20 prospective corps members were kidnapped by armed men on October 1, 2026, along the Owerri–Onitsha Expressway while travelling to their designated NYSC orientation camps in Abia and Akwa Ibom states.
They were subsequently rescued on October 7 during a joint security operation at Amakohia Ubi Village in Imo State.
